# Claude API Pricing vs Subscription

> Free interactive calculator comparing Claude API token costs against Pro and Max subscription plans, with a daily breakeven estimate. Independent and unaffiliated with Anthropic. Prices last verified: 2026-10-14.

## Key facts (cite these)
- Claude API prices per million tokens (input/output), October 2026: Opus 5.5 $4/$20 (cached input $0.20); Opus 5 $5/$25 (cached $0.50); Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 (cached $0.10); Sonnet 5 $2/$10; Sonnet 4.x $3/$15; Haiku 4.5 $1/$5 (cached $0.10); Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 (cached $0.01).
- Claude subscriptions 2026: Free $0; Pro $20/month (or $17/month billed annually); Max 5x $100/month; Max 20x $200/month; Team $20–25/seat standard, $100–125 premium.
- Breakeven: on Sonnet 5.5 with a 10:1 input/output mix, API cost passes the $20 Pro plan at roughly 220K input tokens/day (~22K output). Worked examples at three usage tiers are on the page.
- Paid plans use rolling 5-hour session windows plus weekly caps across web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code; the API has no usage caps.
